Ainu Caravan
locations.description:
Part of the [The Ainu Heirloom](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=483757) quest. The quest names the "Ainu Caravan" as a location to find out more about the heirloom. Talk to the boy by the river to advance and complete the quest.

"I found an Ainu carving. Looks important. Maybe an Ainu caravan can tell me what to do with it."

**Reward(s):**
- Three Flowers

locations.title: Mysterious Merchant
locations.description:
Only available in New Game Plus, Masujiro the Melodious sells unique Vanity Items, Armors, Charms and Sake Capacity upgrades, all in exchange for Ghost Flowers. This includes Cursed Charms that hinder Atsu in exchange for occasionally earning Ghost Flowers from defeated enemies.

Ghost Flowers are otherwise earned by completing quests and activities throughout Yotei. Major tasks like Revenge Quests and Shrine Climbs earn 3, while all other Activities and minor Tales quests earn 2.

locations.title: Bounty Master Armor
locations.description:
A hunter seeks challenge. A killer seeks precision. A bounty is won.

**Location:** Dropped by [Soma the Condemned](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=479832)

**Buffs:**
- Perfect Parry and Perfect Dodge windows are increased by a minor/major/major/major amount, but regular Parries are disabled.
- A Perfect Parry enables 2/2/2/3 additional counterattacks.
- All Spirit Gains are increased by a minor/minor/massive/massive amount.

locations.title: Taro's Armor
locations.description:
An armor for the resilient survivor. Assembled by Taro from the fallen of Ezo.

**Location:** Given by Taro at the [Dead Man's Tree](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480097) during [The Loss We Carry](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480095)

**Buffs:**
- All Spirit gains increased by a minor/moderate/moderate/moderate amount when graced with a cooking Spirit bonus.
- Maximum Health increased by a minor/minor/moderate/moderate amount.
- Fire and Cold damage reduced by a moderate/moderate/minor/major amount.

locations.title: Dragonfly Armor
locations.description:
Daijiro's armor, before forgoing the name Lord Furuya. A note reads: "May your arrows fly with the speed of a dragonfly."

**Location:** Given by Daijiro at the [Huranui's Rest Inn](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480101) after completing the [The Dragonfly Armor](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480171) tale

**Buffs:**
- Fully drawing your bow creates a brief timed glint. Firing an arrow during the glint empowers your shot, moderately/majorly/majorly/majorly increasing its damage and range.
- Firing an empowered Arrow grants a minor/minor/moderate/moderate amount of Concentration.
- Increase Arrow reload speed by a moderate/moderate/moderate/major amount.

locations.title: Spider Lily Armor
locations.description:
The armor of a general, lost to grief. All enemies fall to its bloodthirsty intent.

**Location:** Given at the end of [The Spider Lily General](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480289)

**Buffs:**
- Enemies have a minor/moderate/moderate/moderate chance to drop throwable weapons.
- Stagger damage inflicted by melee weapons increased by a minor/minor/moderate/moderate amount.
- Staggering an enemy has a minor/minor/minor/moderate chance of dealing minor/minor/minor/moderate Stagger damage to nearby enemies.

locations.title: Mercenary Attire
locations.description:
A versatile outfit that hides both dust and blood.

**Location:** In [Ishikari Castle](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480494) after using it as a disguise during [The Oni](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480307)

**Buffs:**
- Thrown Melee weapons deal increased damage by a minor/moderate/moderate/moderate amount and grant a minor/moderate/moderate/moderate amount of Spirit.
- Assassinating an enemy has a moderate/moderate/guaranteed/guaranteed chance of dropping Sake.
- Drinking Sake grants a minor/minor/minor/major amount of additional Spirit.

locations.title: Armor of the Undying
locations.description:
A curse passed on, an armor that stays death. Choose the right weapon, recover what is lost.

**Location:** Dropped by the Undying Samurai in his lair above the coast at the end of [The Undying Samurai](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480582)

**Buffs:**
- If weapon aligned, Staggering enemies restores a minor/major/major/major amount of Health.
- If weapon aligned, the window to perform Perfect Parry and Perfect Dodge is increased by a minor/minor/moderate/moderate amount.
- If weapon aligned, Focus Attacks have a minor/minor/minor/moderate chance to increase Stagger damage.

locations.title: Robes for Sitturaynu
locations.description:
Made by huci to help a lost hunter find their way.

**Location:** Given in [Husko Kotan](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480641) during [The Heart of an Ainu](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480640)

**Buffs:**
- Fireflies and controller vibrations guide you to Altars of Reflections when you are within a 55m/100m/100m/100m distance.
- Golden Birds can lead to Shamisen Songs, Sumi-e Painting locations, Pillars of the Fallen, and Dye Merchants.
- Flowers have a minor/minor/minor/major chance to be automatically collected when riding through white flower trails or stealthing through tall grass.

locations.title: Crimson Kimono
locations.description:
A kimono stained red with blood. Imbued with a mother's love to shroud its wearer from danger.

**Location:** Under a pile of rocks at the [Old Home](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480818) at the end of [The Crimson Kimono](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480813)

**Buffs:**
- Chain Assassinations can be performed with Kunai (max 1/2/2/2 Kunai thrown).
- Enemy detection is reduced by a major/major/massive/massive amount.
- Kusarigama Assassinations can be unleashed from further away. The distance is increased by a minor/minor/minor/major amount.

locations.title: Nine Tail Armor

**Buffs:**
- Quickfire weapon damage and duration of status effects inflicted on enemies are increased by a minor/moderate/moderate/moderate amount.
- Assassinating enemies has a minor chance of granting 1/1/2/2 Quickfire ammo.
- Enemy detection is reduced by a minor/minor/minor/moderate amount.

locations.title: Ginji's Guard Armor
locations.description:
A prototype crafted by Ginji, the armorer, to protect the wearer from incoming gunfire.

**Location:** Found inside a tea barrel in the [Joyo Tea House](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480905) during [Pride Before Tea](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480904)

**Buffs:**
- Increase Tanegashima reload speed by a minor/moderate/moderate/moderate amount.
- Blocking deflects incoming bullets.
- Incoming projectiles inflict less damage by a major/major/major/massive amount.

A man in Ishikari Market claims he's being watched by a mysterious ronin. Wonder why.

**Related Location(s):**
- [Ishikari Market](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480476)

locations.title: The Weight of Coin
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with Takero leaning against a shed

A money lender hired me to deliver a message to a food merchant who owes him coin south of Otaru Beach. Not every job is glamorous.

**Reward(s):**
- 450 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- Near the [Nishin Fishery](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480550)

locations.title: Oni's Breath Inn
locations.description:
**How to start:** Attempt to enter [Oni's Breath Inn](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480512)

Raiders are drinking at Oni's Breath Inn. Could be a good spot for information. Just need to wear a mask to get inside.

**Reward(s):**
- Unlocks the [Zeni Hajiki](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480518) table

**Related Location(s):**
- [Oni's Breath Inn](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480512)

locations.title: A Life to Be
locations.description:
**How to start:** Try to enter the [Unknown Cave](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480524)

I was hired by a father to defend his pregnant wife against the Oni Raiders. I won't let another family's story end in tragedy.

**Reward(s):**
- Optional Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Mother's Cave](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480524)

locations.title: Bold Kaji Forge
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the settler outside of [Gale's Reprieve](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480484)

A weaponsmith is being held captive at his forge west of Nakagoya Spring and Horokanai Bluffs. I know what the Yōtei Six do to blacksmiths that don't cooperate...

**Reward(s):**
- [Charm of Cannon Steps](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480552)

**Related Location(s):**
- [Gale's Reprieve](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480484)

locations.title: Artisanal Treasures
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the woodcarver in a small camp

A woodcarver in Nakagoya Spring hired me and some ronin to recover stolen merchandise from the Oni Raiders. I prefer to work alone, but coin is coin.

**Reward(s):**
- 1,350 Coin

locations.title: Broken Horn Garrison
locations.description:
**How to start:** Approach [Broken Horn Garrison](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480564)

The Oni Raiders have a garrison east of Howling Cove. They've captured a villager. He won't last long on his own.

**Reward(s):**
- [Charm of the Blind Drunk](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480566)

**Related Location(s):**
- [Broken Horn Garrison](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480564)

locations.title: Shelter from the Storm
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the samurai at the [Matsumae Outpost](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480595)

A Matsumae commander said they're missing one of their men. He was last seen near Ishikari Fork.

**Reward(s):**
- 450 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Matsumae Outpost](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480595)

locations.title: Cursed Ground
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the settler in the small camp on the hill

A merchant at Ishikari Fork lost a pair of horses. I said I'd help bring them back.

**Reward(s):**
- 450 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Gale's Reprieve](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480484)

locations.title: The Lost Scouts
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with a samurai at the [Matsumae Encampment](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480542) after liberating the [Masked Man's Quarry](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480543).

A Matsumae Commander hired me to find his missing scouts. They were sent to an outpost north of Nakagoya Spring before they disappeared.

**Reward(s):**
- 450 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Matsumae Encampment](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480542)

locations.title: The Heart of an Ainu
locations.description:
**How to start:** Ride the ferry to the north during [The Kitsune](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=479890)

Huci invited me to trade at Kusko Kotan, northwest of the Northern Ferry. Could be useful.

[Next](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480655)

**Reward(s):**
- [Robes for Sitturaynu](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480645) Armor
- [Traveler's Dawn Headband](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480652)

locations.title: The Load We Bear
locations.description:
**How to start:** Given automatically after completing [The Heart of an Ainu](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480640)

Huci invited me to a meal at Husko Kotan. I haven't had a real meal in ages.

[Previous](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480640)

**Reward(s):**
- [Thoughts on the Ocean Hat](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480662)

locations.description:
**How to start:** Open the door to the [Meiro Caves](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480681)

I heard screams coming from inside a cave north of Kankan Creek, but a group of ronin didn't want me near it.

[Next](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480710)

**Reward(s):**

locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the settler next to the fire at the [Two Brothers' Campsite](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480687)

A settler hired me to find his missing brother in the Sakuru Woods. No one should be left wondering what happened to their sibling.

**Reward(s):**
- [Charm of Fortitude](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480690)

locations.description:
**How to start:** Investigate the dead body in front of the [Contested Farm](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480704)

Farms are being attacked by unseen enemies in Teshio Ridge. I should keep an eye out for farmers in trouble.

[Next](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480769)

**Reward(s):**

locations.description:
**How to start:** Approach the ronin in front of the 

Strange things are happening in a ronin encampment north of the Iwor Mountains. A healer I rescued believes a disease is to blame, but Kanemori's men spoke of a curse...

[Previous](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480682)

locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to the monk in the camp near the [Sakuru Bamboo Strike](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480721)

East of Teshio River, a monk hired me for protection. He's looking into an imposter who serves the Nine Tails.

**Reward(s):**
- 750 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Traveler's Rest](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480723)

locations.title: Soya Port
locations.description:
**How to start:** Approach [Soya Port](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480749)

A weaponsmith is being held by Nine Tails where Sarufutsu River meets the sea. No doubt they'll kill him once he's served his purpose.

**Reward(s):**
- [Charm of Shattering Strike](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480751)

**Related Location(s):**
- [Soya Port](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480749)

locations.title: The Enemy Within
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with Goemon inside the [Kamikawa Trading Post](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480805)

A merchant named Goemon is helping set up a new trading post. I've been hired to find missing supplies northwest of Kamikawa Trading Post.

**Reward(s):**
- 450 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Kamikawa Trading Post](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480805)

locations.title: The Worth of a Blade
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the fortune teller after completing the [Hakodake Bamboo Strike](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480820)

A fortune teller predicted someone will try to take my sword north of Sentinel Forest. I'll need to keep an eye out for ashen trees.

**Related Location(s):**
- [Hakodake Bamboo Strike](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480820)

locations.title: Encounters of the Wild
locations.description:
**How to start:** Enter the [Sarufutsu Lighthouse](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480830)

The Nine Tails have some kind of hideout at Sarufutsu Lighthouse. What are they hiding?

**Reward(s):**
- [Altar of Reflection](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480835)

**Related Location(s):**
- [Sarufutsu Lighthouse](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480830)

locations.title: A Promise of Treasure
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the settler in the attic of a house inside of [Benten Port](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480868)

I bought a map off a father in Benten Port. I wonder if it leads to anything.

**Reward(s):**
- 750 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Benten Port](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480868)

locations.title: The Ainu Heirloom
locations.description:
**How to start:** Inspect the leaf pile on the ground next to the river in a camp

I found an Ainu carving. Looks important. Maybe an Ainu caravan can tell me what to do with it.

**Reward(s):**
- [Ikupasuy](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=483758)
- Flowers (3)

**Related Location(s):**
- [Ainu Camp](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480273)
- [Ainu Caravan](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=502670)

locations.title: The Worth of a Man
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the ronin sitting on the ground inside the [Riverfront Hideout](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484125)

A group of ronin are torturing a Matsumae soldier where Sarubetsu River forks west. I could pay for the Matsumae's release... or free him by force.

**Related Location(s):**
- [Riverfront Hideout](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484125)

locations.title: A Normal Life
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the fisherman on the small dock

**Reward(s):**
- [Bow's Grip Mask](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484132)

locations.title: The Soul of an Instrument
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the Ainu at the [Ainu Musician's Camp](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484147)

An Ainu musician at Yubari Lake offered to play me a song if I help him craft an instrument. I've always wanted to hear someone play the tonkori.

**Reward(s):**
- [Ninkari](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484153)

**Related Location(s):**

locations.title: A Melody of Thoughts
locations.description:
**How to start:** Given automatically after completing [The Soul of an Instrument](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484151)

An Ainu musician offered to show me a traditional tonkori song.He's waiting for me east of Cukpet Hills.

**Reward(s):**
- [Song of the Ainu](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484159)

**Related Location(s):**
- [Ainu Musician's Camp](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=484147)
- [Cukpet Hills Campsite](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480668)

locations.title: Sorrow in Snow
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with the settler next to the bridge

A concerned grandfather asked me to look for his lost grandson. He went hunting in the Hakodake Mountains, but hasn't returned.

[Previous](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480722) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=507634)

**Reward(s):**
- 450 Coins

**Related Location(s):**
- [Red Crane Inn](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480691)

locations.title: Youth Under Fire
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak with Taro next to the road

I found Taro near Tokuyama Hills with a group of refugees. He wants to lead them to the safety, but he's just a kid. I can't let him do this on his own

**Reward(s):**
- 750 Coin

locations.title: That Which We Know
locations.description:
**How to start:** Speak to the Caravan Leader across the road from the Ainu Merchant.

A caravan leader asked me to investigate Hyobee, a suspicious character who bought passage to the mainland. He's currently drinking inside the Red Crane Inn.

**Reward(s):**
- 450 Coin

**Related Location(s):**
- [Red Crane Inn](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480691)

locations.title: A Fleeting Thought
locations.description:
**How to start:** Begins automatically when you get near the location.

Approach the location and defeat the Saito outlaws who are attacking the soldier.

locations.title: The Stick of Fate
locations.description: Leaning against a stone lamp post is a stick. Interacting with it will allow you to point the stick in the direction of danger or an inn.

locations.title: Sly Cooper Mural
locations.description:
On the way to [Faithful Leap Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480278)

Depicts Sir Raleigh the Frog, a boss in Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus.

locations.title: inFamous: Second Son Mural
locations.description:
In the attic, after drinking tea with Master Enomoto during "Way of the Kusarigama"

Depicts the character Delsin.

locations.title: Sucker Punch Team Mural
locations.description:
Found on the beach where Ugetsu boat is.

If you pray, leaves will appear.

locations.title: inFamous: Second Son Mural
locations.description: Another reference to inFamous: Second Son - this one depicts the character Fetch.

locations.title: Hidden Altar
locations.description: Near the shore.

locations.title: Hidden Altar
locations.description: Near the Amber Respite Shrine, in front of the rocks facing the waterfall, in the water

locations.description: In front of the waterfall in the ainu camp, below the [Drying Bark Sumi-e](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480666)

locations.title: Hidden Altar
locations.description: At the base of the waterfall behind Seianji Temple. Dragonflies swarm upon completion.

locations.title: Hidden Altar
locations.description: Next to Hana's farm, you'll see a circle of frog statues.

locations.title: Hidden Altar
locations.description: By a burned cart just south Dying Fire Wolf Den

locations.title: Hidden Altar
locations.description: On the rocks to the left of the first thin bamboo bridge as you go up the [Faithful Leap Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480278).

locations.title: Hidden altar
locations.description: Next to the hot spring there is a elevated point facing mount yotei. Face the mountain and bow at the edge of the point

locations.title: Hidden Altar
locations.description: Bow at the rock lantern marked by the Clan Sakai symbol for maple leaves to fly around you.

locations.title: Treasure Map Location
locations.description: Destination of the "[A Promise of Treasure](https://mapgenie.io/ghost-of-yotei/maps/yotei?locationIds=480869)" Tale. Will be a pale brown box inside a tiny rock shelter at the base of the cliff.

locations.title: Horse Rescue
locations.description: A settler can be found here trying to calm his horse. Help him for a modest reward.

charms.name: Charm of Howling Terror
charms.effect: Reduce the kill streak requirement of Onryo's Howl by 1.
charms.howToGet: Obtained from the Onryo Gift Altar after completing The Kitsune quest

charms.name: Charm of Takemikazuchi
charms.effect: Heavenly Slash has a moderate chance to unleash a lightning strike against a nearby enemy. There is a 30 second cooldown between successful strikes.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Budding Grace Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Masakado
charms.effect: Onryo's Will revives you at full health.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Amber Respite Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Yamatotakeru
charms.effect: Earn a moderate amount of Spirit after Disarming or killing an enemy with a thrown Melee weapon.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Patient Frost Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Amenowakahiko
charms.effect: Headshots have a moderate chance to earn Spirit.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Blooming Ridge Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Kibitsuhiko
charms.effect: Land headshots while using Concentration to extend its duration by a minor amount.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Risen Fog Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Amaterasu
charms.effect: Defeating enemies regains a moderate amount of Health.
charms.howToGet: Obtained by purchasing the Deluxe Edition

charms.name: Charm of Izanagi
charms.effect: All types of Assassinations regain a minor amount of Health.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Sun's Peak Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Masaka
charms.effect: Using a Smoke Bomb regains a minor amount of Health.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Enduring Hold Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Sukunahikona
charms.effect: Earn Health at a minor rate while not in combat.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Chilled Peak Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Eager Revenge
charms.effect: Reduce the kill streak requirement of Ghost Stance by 1.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Taro the Scavenger

charms.name: Charm of Raining Arrows
charms.effect: The Hakyu rapidly fires arrows with automatic aim. Arrow damage is increased by moderate amount, but disables headshots.
charms.howToGet: Complete Secrets of the Heart side quest at Teshio Ridge

charms.name: Charm of Futsunushi
charms.effect: Parries, Perfect Parries, and Perfect Dodges are easier to perform.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Faithful Leap Shrine

charms.name: Charm of Onryo's Protection
charms.effect: Taking damage reduces kill streak count by 2 instead of resetting it. Kill streaks power Onryo's Howl and other deadly techniques.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Taro the Scavenger

charms.name: Charm of Taming
charms.effect: Playing the shamisen turns nearby hostile animals into allies.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of Onryo's Wrath
charms.effect: After using Onryo's Will, you have a minor chance to trigger Onryo's Howl.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of Mauling
charms.effect: Wolf attacks make enemies Vulnerable for a moderate duration. All weapons inflict maximum damage regardless of enemy weapon type.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of Iron Grip
charms.effect: You cannot be disarmed.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of Confusion
charms.effect: Assassinations on enemy Leaders will Confuse them, turning them into an ally for a short duration. The Leader dies when the effect ends.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of Terrors
charms.effect: Increases all chances to Terrify by a minor amount.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of Wolf Stalking
charms.effect: Assassinations in areas where the wolf can be summoned have a minor chance to summon the wolf instantly. The wolf performs a stealth assassination if able.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of Drunken Mastery
charms.effect: While drunk, enemies are Vulnerable. All weapons inflict maximum damage regardless of weapon type.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of the Drunkard
charms.effect: While drunk, your attacks are unblockable, but you will be unable to block enemy attacks. Your drunken state will last longer for a minor duration.
charms.howToGet: Bought from Masujiro the Melodious

charms.name: Charm of True Aim
charms.effect: The Yumi locks-on to an enemy and fires 1 arrow, inflicting massive damage.
charms.howToGet: Obtained after completing the The Legend of Opusnupuri myth quest

charms.name: Charm of Hachiman
charms.effect: Maximum Standoff Streak increased by 1. After a successful Standoff, an additional enemy will rush in and open themselves to a killing blow.
charms.howToGet: Obtained as you progress throught The Oni quest line.

charms.name: Charm of Homusubi
charms.effect: Inflict increased Fire damage to enemies.
charms.howToGet: Found in the Winding Tears Shrine at the end of a path
